verdict.rationale: AgentMail's evidence documents email infrastructure for agents: inboxes, messages, keyword full-text search, webhooks, an MCP server and a CLI. Nothing shows the product itself generating AI insights or suggestions from the user's data. The LangChain vector-store integration and MCP tools are developer building blocks for external agents rather than in-product AI insights, and keyword search is an adjacent feature, so none of them earn credit.
